title: HPC Account Set up and Access
author: Courtney Comrie
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7ezhjf6
materials: You are now in our lab directory.
Select the link on the page.

steps.title: Open HPC web interface
steps.instruction: Navigate to the main HPC information webpage and select the web interface option under the Services section.

steps.title: Request account addition
steps.instruction: Enter Dr. Hutchinson's email (hutchinsone@email.arizona.edu) into the sponsor's email box so she can add you to the drive.

steps.title: Await account approval
steps.instruction: Wait until you are accepted onto the lab HPC account before proceeding.

steps.title: Log into HPC web portal
steps.instruction: After access is granted, log into the web interface with your NetID and password; this will bring you to the main portal page.

steps.title: Navigate to research group folder
steps.instruction: In the portal, go to the Files tab, open the /rsgrps directory, and select the research group named "hutchinsone".

steps.title: Launch Ocelote Desktop
steps.instruction: Under the Interactive Apps tab, select Ocelote Desktop (do NOT choose ElGato Desktop).

substeps.instruction: Run Time – Enter the amount of time you plan on clocking in that day; give yourself enough time to complete jobs to avoid session termination.
Core Count – Choose the number of cores on a single node based on data size (larger data files require more cores).
Special Option – Leave this field blank.
